headline: Australians Set to Live Nearly a Decade Longer by 2066
meta_description: Life expectancy in Australia is projected to rise significantly by 2065/66, with women reaching almost 90 and men 86, according to Treasury analysis.
summary_short: Australian life expectancy is climbing. Women are projected to live to almost 90 by 2065/66, up from about 86 today, with men reaching 86 from 82.
body:
Australian women are expected to live almost to 90 by 2065/66, while men will reach 86—a significant leap from current life expectancies of about 86 for women and 82 for men. The Treasury's projections reveal a nation enjoying steadily improving health outcomes across the board.

These gains reflect decades of medical advancement, public health improvements, and broader access to healthcare. The projected increases represent roughly four additional years of life for Australian women and about four years for men over the next four decades.
quick_facts: Women's life expectancy rising to almost 90 by 2065/66
Men's life expectancy climbing to 86 by 2065/66
Current baseline: 86 for women, 82 for men
Treasury projects these long-term health improvements
